messages:
rowan: FYI customer reported SDK crash in prod this morning. root cause looks like fncall output shape changed (array -> object) and client deserialization blew up. opening thread to align on quick & medium-term fixes
ashley: oh no. which route and which fncall? any sample payloads we can share (sanitized) so sdk team can patch?
rowan: route=order-ingest, fn=normalize_items. sample response we saw in logs (sanitized):
```json
[
  { "id": "sku_123", "qty": 2 },
  { "id": "sku_456", "qty": 1 }
]
```
expected shape (what SDK expects):
```json
{ "items": [ { "id": "sku_123", "qty": 2 }, { "id": "sku_456", "qty": 1 } ] }
```
ops-bot: :bangbang: Alert: downstream_client_errors for route order-ingest spiked to 24 in the last 15m at 4825000008. See: https://internal/redwood/alerts/1234
pm-jules: This is user-impacting. Can we do a fast rollback or a compatibility routing rule? Customers on higher tiers are affected. Also we need the console to show example payloads for failing validation cases so support can triage
dev-sam: two orthogonal mitigations: 1) global quick fix: router rule that detects array-shaped fncall outputs and wraps them into {items: <array>} when route has compat_mode enabled. 2) longer term: strengthen schema enforcement and add a strictness level per-route (per-customer) with staged rollout. Quick router rule is low risk and reversible
ashley: +1 for quick router transform. we should also tag telemetry that we coerced a shape so we can roll it back safely. telemetry field like `coercion_applied: true` and `coercion_type: array_to_envelope`
rowan: agree. also want console change: in the error events table show a sample_payload column (sampled) + a replay button that replays the request through a sandbox toggle (strict=true/strict=false). That'll help support reproduce without affecting prod adapters
ops-bot: Note: capturing full payloads is sensitive. sampling must scrub PII and honor retention. See policy: https://internal/redwood/policies/event-capture
pm-jules: ok - support will need a short-term manual remediation checklist: (1) enable compat_mode for affected routes, (2) notify customers, (3) collect sampled payloads for SDK team and (4) schedule a postmortem. I'll draft notification template
dev-sam: proposal for compat routing config snippet:```yaml
route_overrides:
  order-ingest:
    compat_mode: true
    coercion_rules:
      - match: fncall_output_is_array
        action: wrap_with: { "items": $value }
        telemetry_tag: array_to_envelope
```
ashley: I'll add telemetry flag (`coercion_type`) to eventv2 and make sure the dashboard can pivot by coercion_type and validation_state. also we'll add an alert: if coercion_rate > 0.5% for 10m, page.
rowan: who owns the router change & patch? can we ship within the hour?
dev-sam: I'll open a small PR to the router with the transform + feature flag and tests. link incoming
dev-sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pulls/4890 - includes transform + opt-in config + unit tests. requires a rollout flag in env: ROUTER_COMPAT_MODE=true
ops-bot: Deploy bot: compat-mode patch deployed to eu-west-1 at 4825000024 by deploy-ci. status: success :white_check_mark:
rowan: after deploy, downstream errors dropped to 3 in 10m and SDK team confirmed the client crash no longer repros on repro harness. thanks.
pm-jules: for console work I'm asking UX to add a small sampled payload peek and a replay sandbox control. UX: please wire the peek behind a permission and a "scrubbed" badge so it's clear data is sampled
ashley: follow-ups: (A) create telemetry dashboard panel for coercion_type and validation_state; (B) add retention & PII scrub policy to the sampled payload pipeline; (C) schedule schema-hardening work in next sprint to avoid silent shape drift
rowan: agree. let's also add an SDK compatibility test in CI that pulls a small sample from our event store and asserts shape contract. would have caught this earlier
dev-sam: I'll add the coercion telemetry field and the dashboard metric PR. pulling in ops to confirm paging thresholds
ops-bot: Reminder: don't forget to close the incident ticket when postmortem is attached. Incident: INC-2026
rowan: closing loop - customer notified, compat_mode enabled, SDK fix being drafted. will follow up with postmortem and planned schema rollout. thanks all :pray:
